nodes.summary: For an integer $n \ge -1$ and a complex number $x$, $f(n, x) = 1$ if $n = -1$, and otherwise $f(n, x)$ is the generalized Bell function $F(0, 1, x; n) = e^{-x} \sum_{k \ge 0} (k + 1)^n x^{k + 1} / k!$.
nodes.title: Generalized Bell function extended to $n = -1$

nodes.summary: For complex numbers $a$, $b$, $x$ and a natural number $n$, the generalized Bell function is $F(a, b, x; n) = e^{-x} \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{(a + b(k + 1))^n x^{k+1}}{k!}$.
nodes.title: Ramanujan's generalized Bell function

nodes.summary: For every complex number $x$ and every natural number $n$, the series $\sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \frac{(j+1)^n x^{j+1}}{j!}$ converges absolutely.
nodes.title: Absolute convergence of Ramanujan's Bell-type series (Entry 4)

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be Ramanujan's generalized Bell function. For all complex numbers $a$ and $x$, let $f(x, n) = F(0, 1, x; n) = e^{-x} \sum_{j=0}^{\infty} \frac{(j+1)^n x^{j+1}}{j!}$ for natural numbers $n$, and set $f(x, -1) = 1$. Then the series $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{a^n}{n!} f(x, n-1)$ converges absolutely and its sum is $e^{x(e^a - 1)}$.
nodes.title: Exponential generating function of Ramanujan's Bell-type series (Entry 4)

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be Ramanujan's generalized Bell function. For every natural number $n$ and every complex number $x$, write $f(x, m) = F(0, 1, x; m)$ for natural numbers $m$, and set $f(x, -1) = 1$. Then $f(x, n) = x \sum_{k=0}^{n} \binom{n}{k} f(x, k-1)$.
nodes.title: Binomial recurrence for Ramanujan's Bell-type series (Entry 5)

nodes.summary: Let $F$ denote Ramanujan's generalized Bell function. For complex numbers $a$, $b$, $x$ and every natural number $n$, the series $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} (a + b(k + 1))^n x^{k+1} / k!$ converges absolutely and its sum is $e^{x} F(a, b, x; n)$.
nodes.title: Convergence of the generalized Bell series

nodes.summary: Let $F(a, b, x; n)$ be Ramanujan's generalized Bell function. For all complex numbers $a$, $b$, $x$ and $y$, the series $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{y^n}{n!} F(a, b, x; n)$ converges to $x e^{(a+b)y} e^{x(e^{by} - 1)}$.
nodes.title: Exponential generating function of the generalized Bell function (Entry 9(ii))

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be the generalized Bell function extended to $n = -1$. For every natural number $m$ and every complex number $x$, the complex-valued function $t \mapsto x f(m - 1, t x)$ of a real variable $t$ is interval integrable on $[0, 1]$ with respect to Lebesgue measure.
